gloss: this world; the present life; this life

definitions.gloss: this world; the present life; this life
definitions.explanation: The current world or lifetime, as opposed to the afterlife or past/future lives. A concept rooted in Buddhist thought, contrasting with the previous life and the next life.

examples.japanese: {現世|げんせ}での{幸|しあわ}せを{願|ねが}う。
examples.english: To wish for happiness in this life.

examples.japanese: {仏教|ぶっきょう}では{現世|げんせ}の{行|おこな}いが{来世|らいせ}に{影響|えいきょう}すると{考|かんが}えられている。
examples.english: In Buddhism, one's actions in this life are believed to affect the next life.

examples.japanese: {現世|げんせ}{利益|りやく}を{求|もと}めてお{寺|てら}に{参|まい}る{人|ひと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people visit temples seeking worldly benefits.

notes:
A Buddhist-origin concept referring to the present existence. In Buddhist cosmology, existence is divided into three phases: {前世|ぜんせ} (previous life), {現世|げんせ} (this life), and {来世|らいせ} (next life).

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also read as げんせい or うつしよ. The reading うつしよ has a more literary, Shinto-influenced nuance meaning "the visible/real world" as opposed to the spirit world.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現世|げんせ}{利益|りやく}: worldly benefits (blessings sought through prayer for this life)
- {現世|げんせ}での{行|おこな}い: one's conduct in this life
- {現世|げんせ}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy this life

RELATED WORDS:
- {前世|ぜんせ}: previous life — the life before this one
- {来世|らいせ}: next life, afterlife — the life after this one
- {三世|さんぜ}: three worlds/lives — past, present, and future existences
- {浮世|うきよ}: the floating world — the transient, pleasure-seeking world (Edo-era concept)
